items.question: Under what condition are beings tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: A fixed count of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams is specified.
Beings are located within those womb-diagrams.
Those beings are described as tormented in that setting.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment while situated in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The agent or cause of torment is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: In the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
